Payout of 12 August is short ₹1,019.99.
The bank credited ₹1,48,808.94 against an expected ₹1,49,828.93. 13 orders sit in this payout. No refund, chargeback or payment in the gateway ledger accounts for the difference, so the cause is not yet identified.
Suggested action: request the gateway's own breakdown for this payout, and check for a dispute debited but not yet reported.
